choices.return_definition: x_t = NDX_t / NDX_(t-1) - 1 - RF_t / 100, with NDX_(t-1) the previous NDX close (the previous trading day), computed before any day is dropped for want of RF
choices.trading_day_without_rf: dropped from the sample after its return is computed; the next day's return is still taken against that dropped day's close
choices.n_dropped_scope: every listed announcement day that is not an NDX day with a close, over the whole NDX file, irrespective of sample window; an announcement day that is an NDX trading day but lacks RF is not in n_dropped and is counted separately below
choices.sample_windows: full = sample days with date >= 1994-02-01; OOS = sample days with date >= 2016-01-01, both to the last day with a return and RF
choices.shift_range: k = 5 .. n - 5 inclusive at both ends, n the number of days in the window being tested; n_shifts = n - 9
choices.shift_comparison: a rotation counts when its difference is >= the observed difference (float comparison, no tolerance)
choices.day_before: the announcement indicator moved one trading day earlier on the sample series (A_before[i] = A[i+1], last element 0), then restricted to the window; shift test rotates A_before
choices.two_day: w_t = x_(t-1) + x_t on the sample series (sum, not compounded), compared on announcement days against all other days with w defined; shift test rotates A over those days
choices.nw_t_oos: t of the announcement-day mean a + b from x = a + b A + e, Newey-West Bartlett L = 5, weights 1 - l / (L + 1), no small-sample correction; nw_t_diff_oos is the t of b alone
choices.mean_bp: means of x in basis points (x * 1e4)
choices.share_positive_all: share of all OOS sample days (announcement days included) with x > 0
choices.by_year_units: sums of x in decimals; one row per calendar year present in the OOS sample, including years with no announcement day
choices.criteria_primary: d_oos > 0 and p_shift_oos <= 0.025, evaluated regardless of the sample floor; the verdict applies the floor (INSUFFICIENT below 60 OOS announcement days)
choices.strategy_days: QQQ trading days (rows with an adjusted close) from 2016-01-01 with RF, QQQ return against QQQ's previous close; announcement days are listed days that are NDX trading days
choices.strategy_cost: window return minus 2 x 2 bp = 4 bp on each announcement day; cash days earn RF_t / 100
choices.sharpe: mean(r - RF) / std(r - RF, ddof = 1) * sqrt(252)
